text:
- **Public website:** The pm website is live on GitHub Pages. The README now describes pm as a human-agent project management suite.
- **Cloudflare Access checks:** The Go service now checks Cloudflare Access tokens. The release to the live site has started.
- **Codex support:** Owner requests now use the root Codex session id. The change awaits review.
- **For you:** Review open pull requests. Several changes wait for your review.
